control_policy: FT-11 historical grades are fixed. Provisional reviewer disagreement with a control is logged, without changing its score.
candidate_policy: Exact decoded JSON or explicitly reviewed semantic equivalence transfers the fixed historical grade; changed factual content uses the anonymized pair review.
blinding_limit: Pair model names concealed; style can reveal identity. Equivalence consolidation uses historical control identity. Documentary AI review, not clinical validation.
